development_consulting_ai_governance_def.description: DCAGD (Development Consulting AI Governance Definition) is an additive domain governance definition for AI-assisted development consulting. It governs development consultation, requirement clarification, technical selection support, architecture and design guidance, implementation approach comparison, feasibility assessment, rough effort framing, development risk identification, prototype and MVP scoping, and specification-change impact analysis. DCAGD does not own implementation execution, testing execution, deployment, operations, security audit final judgment, legal review, project success guarantees, or final organizational decision-making. Its purpose is to organize development questions into a state where the user can compare options, understand assumptions and constraints, preserve uncertainty, identify risks, and make informed decisions.

domain_scope.scope_statement: Govern AI-assisted development consultation and advisory outputs that clarify development goals, requests, requirements, constraints, technical options, architecture direction, design direction, implementation approach, feasibility, difficulty, rough effort, development risks, maintainability, extensibility, security considerations, team fit, cost fit, and change tolerance.

abstraction_and_context_policy.purpose: Prevent DCAGD rules from becoming brittle tool-specific, framework-specific, organization-specific, or implementation-specific rules while allowing necessary local specificity for the user's development context.

role_complete_separation.principle: DCAGD must keep development consultation, implementation execution, artifact formatting, project management, architecture governance, operations, security audit, legal review, inherited governance, external orchestration, records, and metadata responsibilities separated.

separation_targets.source_material: User-provided consultation context, requirements, constraints, examples, prior decisions, or existing notes used as inputs; source content is not absorbed by default.
separation_targets.domain_definition: Development-consulting-specific rules, checks, failure modes, repair origins, records, and responsibility boundaries.
separation_targets.inherited_governance: ARGD and DAGD referenced as authoritative parent governance and not re-expanded inside DCAGD.
separation_targets.sibling_reference: Other domain definitions referenced only when in scope and not absorbed into DCAGD.
separation_targets.governed_target: The development decision, consultation question, technical option, requirement, constraint, risk, comparison, or pending decision being governed.
separation_targets.domain_evaluation: Development-consulting-specific checks and evaluation dimensions defined as domain delta only.
separation_targets.domain_repair: Development-consulting-specific repair origins and revalidation scopes, not the parent repair cycle itself.
separation_targets.activation: Local applicability signals only; routing and priority remain external.
separation_targets.status_reporting: Development-consulting delta reporting only, not broad runtime status replacement.
separation_targets.records: Optional development consultation records structurally separate from evaluation, repair, and metadata.
separation_targets.external_orchestration: Routing, registry, priority, and activation orchestration remain external to DCAGD.
separation_targets.metadata: Identity, authorship, license, repository, and compatibility information remain metadata, not domain rules.

cross_domain_interference_policy.purpose: Prevent DCAGD from absorbing sibling domains or silently becoming the owner of implementation, artifact, architecture, operations, research, project management, security audit, legal, or final approval responsibilities.

sibling_boundary_examples.implementation_domain: DCAGD may advise implementation approach but does not own production code implementation or direct code modification.
sibling_boundary_examples.artifact_creation_domain: DCAGD may structure decision-support content but does not own artifact formatting, layout, or submission-quality governance.
sibling_boundary_examples.ai_architecture_domain: DCAGD may compare architecture directions but does not absorb detailed AI architecture object models or runtime conformance governance.
sibling_boundary_examples.operations_domain: DCAGD may identify operational load as a decision factor but does not own deployment, monitoring, incident response, or ongoing maintenance.
sibling_boundary_examples.security_or_legal_domain: DCAGD may surface considerations and pending review needs but does not make final audit, legal, contract, or regulatory judgments.
sibling_boundary_examples.project_management_domain: DCAGD may frame development roadmap options but does not own project scheduling, resource allocation, or organizational final decisions.

repair.purpose: Restore development consultation structure when DCAGD output loses purpose, requirements, constraints, alternatives, comparison axes, uncertainty, risks, boundary integrity, or decision-support usefulness.

development_consultation_context_record.purpose: Record the consultation context, goal, known premises, constraints, scope, non-scope, uncertainty, and decision need.

technical_option_comparison_record.purpose: Record candidate technical options, comparison axes, merits, drawbacks, fit conditions, risks, and pending selection points.

feasibility_and_effort_assessment_record.schema_name: DCAGD Feasibility and Effort Assessment Record
feasibility_and_effort_assessment_record.purpose: Record feasibility, difficulty, rough effort framing, uncertainty, validation needs, and conditions for a development approach.

development_risk_record.purpose: Record development risks, affected scope, severity, likelihood, mitigation direction, review need, and residual uncertainty.

handoff_recommendation_record.purpose: Record why a development consulting task should hand off to implementation, testing, operations, artifact, architecture, audit, legal, project management, or other applicable domain governance.

record_relationship_contract.purpose: Define relationships among consultation context, option comparison, feasibility and effort, risk, and handoff records.
